bullet_facts.fact: Pam and Roy were engaged but broke up before their wedding.
Roy expressed that he wanted to win Pam back after their breakup.
Pam and Roy had a complicated relationship, with Pam feeling the relationship was over by the time of the breakup.
Pam is currently not dating Roy and considers their relationship to be over.

supporting_quotes.quote: Pam: Yeah, I didn't go through with the wedding. I got cold feet, a few days before. And I can't really explain it. I just had to get out of that relationship.
